chapter: Blanton, Los Angeles and Art Tatum
title: Benny Goodman the taskmaster and his glare
summary: Stewart got along with Goodman by staying out of his way; Goodman was a perfectionist known for the glare.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Who were some of those? Do you remember who they were?
Oh, well, those I can't throw out of my mind.
But there are, were a few that --
Well, I mean besides Benny Goodman to you.

Oh, Benny Goodman. Well, anyway, Benny was very good to work with. I knew how to handle him, you know, and, of course, I stayed out of his way, one thing. That's how we got along so very well. Benny was really a taskmaster, you know, so -- he wants everything perfect, and
if you're not doing the right, playing the right notes to suit him, what have you, he goes four eyes. He'll get that glare, you know. That's what they used to call him, a four eye, the glare.
I knew how to get along with him, though.
